title: workspace.run: evaluate every cell of a workspace in order

presentation.description: The text of a presentation file the context names, when it is not shipped.

summands.description: Draw up to this many summands of each definition (as written) and watch (normal form) in 'summands'.

scalars.description: Names to add to the context's scalars, such as the unknowns of solve cells that are not part of this workspace.

term.description: def: the elaborated term; watch: the watched term with definitions substituted, before simplifying.

terms.description: def and watch: the number of summands (of the term as written for def, of the normal form for watch).

summands.description: def and watch, when the request asks: the first summands, drawn.

certified_by.description: check: as in check; watch: as in simplify.

warnings.description: Things the result does not show, one sentence each, formulas as TeX between $ signs: an idempotent e(...) or identity 1_... whose object is not one of the context's (of another weight nu), which is 0 here and makes every product through it 0.

tier.description: solve: 1 for a linear system, 2 for Gröbner bases.

outcome.description: solve: what the solution set is.

equations.description: solve: the number of coefficient equations.

solution.description: solve, tier 1 unique: a value for each unknown.

directions.description: solve, tier 1 family: a basis of the solutions of the homogeneous system.

dimension.description: solve, family: the dimension of the solution set.

variables.description: solve, tier 2: the unknowns, in the order of points.

points.description: solve, tier 2 finite: the solutions in the ground field.
